title: Automatic Screenshot Uploader
description: Automatically upload any screenshot to a discord webhook
body:
Automatic Screenshot Uploader is a lightweight client-side Minecraft mod that automatically sends your screenshots to a Discord webhook.
Simply take a screenshot in-game and it will be instantly uploaded to your selected Discord channel—no manual sharing needed.
Client-side only. Fully configurable webhook in config/screenshotuploader.properties or in the [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) configuration.
